## About

This page summarizes work related to chapter 4 of *Statistical Rethinking* [-@McElreath2020-fg].

## Setup

Source key libraries for more efficient and readable code.

```{r}
library(rethinking)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 4.1

```{r}
#| label: fig-hist-random-walk
pos <- replicate(n = 1000, sum(runif(n = 16, min = -1, max = 1)))

hist(pos)
```

To replicate Figure 4.2.

```{r}
rw <- function(steps = 1, n = 50) {
  df <- data.frame(trajectory = 1:n, step = rep(0, n), pos = rep(0, n))
  this_df <- df
  for (i in 1:steps) {
    new_pos <- this_df$pos + runif(n, -1, 1)
    this_df <- data.frame(trajectory = 1:n, step = rep(i, n), pos = new_pos)
    df <- rbind(df, this_df)
  }
  df
}
```

```{r}
rw16 <- rw(16)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-random-walks
rw16 |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = step, y = pos, group = trajectory), alpha = 0.2)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hist-position
rw16 |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = pos), bins = 12)
```

### 4.1.2

```{r}
#| label: fig-prod-4.3
growth <- replicate(n = 10000, prod(1 + runif(12, 0, 0.2)))
dens(growth, norm.comp=TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-prod-4.4

big <- replicate(10000, prod(1 + runif(12, 0, 0.5)))
small <- replicate(10000, prod(1 + runif(12, 0, .01)))
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Big product

```{r}
#| label: fig-prod-4.4-big

dens(big, norm.comp = TRUE)
```

## Small product

```{r}
#| label: fig-prod-4.4-small

dens(small, norm.comp = TRUE)
```

:::

### 4.1.3

```{r}
#| label: fig-prod-4.5-log
log.big <- replicate(10000, log(prod(1 + runif(12, 0, 0.5))))
dens(log.big, norm.comp = TRUE)
```

So, the log product is nearly Gaussian.

### 4.1.4

Merely as an exercise to practice LaTex, here is the equation on p. 76:

$$p(y|\mu,\sigma)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\sigma^2}}exp(-\frac{(y-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2})$$

Let's also try the $\tau$ version:

$$p(y|\mu,\tau)=\sqrt{\frac{\tau}{2\pi}}exp(-\frac{1}{2}\tau(y-\mu)^2)$$
